verdict.rationale: An audit log of cap table changes is a fair question for cap table management software, but the evidence pack never mentions audit logs, change history, or per-change attribution of who, what, when and under what authorization. The board sign-off and e-signing flows, admin visibility controls and 2FA are related features, not a change log, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, every change to the cap table is captured in an audit log — who changed what, when, and under what authorization
